test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect form:

He asked me, “Have you done your homework?”

options.text: He asked me if I had done my homework.
He asked me have I done my homework.
He asked me whether I have done my homework.
He asked me whether had I done my homework.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked me if I had done my homework.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Have you done your homework?" becomes "if I had done my homework"**
 
 
• Auxiliary verb "have" is changed to "had" to match past perfect tense.
 
• Pronoun "you" is replaced with "I" to align with the perspective of indirect speech.
 
• The question format is changed to a statement format by removing the question mark.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "asked" is retained in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is structured as a statement rather than a question.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He asked me if I had done my homework."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "He asked me have I done my homework."

 
 
• Incorrect structure: "have I done" is not suitable for indirect speech.
 
• Does not follow tense conversion rules.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He asked me whether I have done my homework."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "have done" should be changed to "had done" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He asked me whether had I done my homework."
 
 
• Incorrect word order: "had I done" should be "I had done".
